title: Objectwise extension of an invertible presheaf translation
statement: Let $(C,J)$ be a small site, $s:C\simeq C$ an equivalence with both directions continuous, $R$ a commutative ring sheaf, and $a:(s^{-1})^*R\simeq R$. Let $S:\operatorname{Site}(J,s,R,a)$ have the integer-labelled category and inclusion $i$ of [def-sf-twisted-action-presentation-data]. For every presheaf $F:C^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sets}$ and natural isomorphism $\tau:(s^{-1})^{\mathrm{op}}F\simeq F$, there are a presheaf $G$ on the copied-object category of $S$ and a natural isomorphism $c:i^{\mathrm{op}}G\simeq F$ such that $G(\gamma_X)\,c_{s^{-1}X}=c_X\,\tau_X^{-1}$ for every $X$, where $\gamma_X$ is the arrow labelled $(-1,\mathrm{id}_{s^{-1}X})$. This conclusion asserts no sheaf condition, equivalence of categories, or lifting of morphisms.

proof.text: Derive the left and right unit equations for powerComp by applying the arrow bijections to the identity laws. Apply the arrow bijections to associativity of three pure power arrows to obtain the pentagon, including the equality transport between the two associations of their integer sum.

Normalize powerComp by allowing its sum to be named explicitly. For a presheaf F and the given translation isomorphism tau, define a downward step from the n-th precomposition to the (n-1)-st precomposition by tau inverse followed by the inverse power comparison. Define the isomorphism from F to its n-th precomposition by integer recursion: use these steps downward and their inverses upward, starting from the identity at zero. The unit equation identifies the minus-one iterate with tau inverse.

Use the pentagon for the labels minus one, n and m and the interchange law for whiskering natural isomorphisms to show that one downward step commutes with combining powers. Prove multiplicativity of the recursively defined iterates by integer induction in n. The downward step uses that compatibility directly; the upward step uses cancellation of the same step isomorphism.

For an arrow with label (n,f), define its contravariant action by the n-th iterate followed by F applied to f opposite. The identity law follows from the zeroth iterate. Multiplicativity and naturality of the iterates give the composition law using arrows_comp. This defines a presheaf on the category induced along inclusion.obj. Its restriction to degree-zero arrows is F and its minus-one generator acts by tau inverse. The induced functor to Object C is fully faithful and surjective on objects by inclusion_obj, hence an equivalence. Transport the presheaf along its inverse; its unit isomorphism supplies the restriction comparison and naturality supplies the generator equation.

lean.statement:
theorem twistedPresheafExtension (S : Site J s R a) (F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (τ : s.inverse.op ⋙ F ≅ F) :
    letI := S.category
    ∃ (G : (Object C)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (c : S.inclusion.op ⋙ G ≅ F),
      ∀ X : C,
        G.map ((S.arrows (s.inverse.obj X) X).symm ⟨-1, 𝟙 _⟩).op ≫
            c.hom.app (op (s.inverse.obj X)) =
          c.hom.app (op X) ≫ τ.inv.app (op X)
